description: This Java class 'StoppedKamonTimer' implements a timer that integrates with Kamon for metrics collection. It manages timing, tagging, and reporting of elapsed durations, and handles stopping segments and recording metrics.

classes.name: StoppedKamonTimer
classes.description: A Kamon-based implementation of a timer that records elapsed time and tags, and interacts with Kamon metrics.

methods.name: fromStartedTimer
methods.description: Creates a StoppedKamonTimer instance from a StartedTimer object.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the timer as a Duration object.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns a copy of the tags associated with the timer.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getKamonInternalTimer
methods.description: Returns the Kamon Timer object with associated tags.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the timer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the timer object.

methods.name: getElapsedNano
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed nanoseconds between start and end timestamps.
